flights.log: The Little Dart flew like a dream, a smooth loop around the outpost and a perfect landing. It's a beautiful little ship, though I wish it could go faster.
The Little Dart Mk II soared through the air, the exhaust system performing flawlessly. It was a perfect test flight. The wind picked up during the descent, but the Little Dart handled it well.
The Little Dart Mk II did not cooperate on its first flight. The engine's erratic performance was concerning, but I managed to guide it back home. I'll need to investigate why the engine sputtered.

During my Little Dart Mk II flight, I was buzzing around the outpost when the engine started acting up. It sputtered and almost dipped, but I managed to bring it under control just in time to land safely. Thankfully, the exhaust systems were in good shape.
The Little Dart Mk II did a perfect loop and returned safely. The hazy weather made for an interesting view, but the flight was smooth and steady.

The Little Dart Mk II lit up the night with its twin red eyes and soared like a comet over Rustwell Outpost. It performed a flawless loop and landed with a gentle thud, leaving a wake of stars in the haze.
